caption: The drawing depicts a scene featuring a horse-drawn carriage with two large white horses at the right, both harnessed and shown in motion, their legs lifted as if trotting or running. The carriage is brown with large spoked wheels and has a green upholstered or draped section, within which a person with dark hair and a blue garment is visible, raising one arm. A man in a blue coat, white trousers, and a black hat stands beside the left rear wheel, holding a whip. To the right of the carriage, a woman with dark hair and a green jacket stands, holding the reins of the horses. The background is filled with stylized, colorful, and swirling plant forms in shades of green, pink, orange, and white, which frame the scene on both sides and from above. The ground is represented with undulating green and brown shapes beneath the carriage and horses. The entire scene is framed by a striped border in blue, gray, and white tones, enclosing the composition. The dominant colors in the drawing are shades of orange, green, brown, white, blue, pink, and black.
title: Chest of Native Pine Painted in Oil
